name: ash-simd
description: 128-bit vector primitives for HashLink: simd.hdll on stock hl, vector instructions on ash
releasenote: A checkout without a built simd.hdll warns instead of stopping the build, and stages a library built under the repository's target directory. -D ash_simd_require_hdll makes a missing one an error. The README says the Vec indices are byte offsets.
